https://www.rugbymfg.com/products/elimin.title: Eliminator Medium Duty / Titan Dump Bodies / Contractor Dump Bodies
intro: Eliminator Medium Duty: Maximize your payload by matching a Rugby Eliminator Medium Duty dump body with your powerful new cab chassis. The Eliminator Medium Duty has been engineered to haul more when paired with a 22,000 GVWR chassis. Built with a versatile cabshield option, the Eliminator Medium Duty can adapt to fit on any major OEM’s medium duty chassis. Featuring the innvoations and top quality you expect from Rugby, this steel dump body is ready to work for you. These carbon steel units are available in 9′ – 12′ lengths with 20″ side height and 26″ tailgate height.

Titan Dump Bodies: Rugby® customers have come to expect the high quality and durability with which our bodies are built, and Rugby looks forward to the challenges of producing bodies that meet the needs and high demands of our customers. As a result, we now present our heavy-duty Titan. Featuring a dirt-shedding top rail, 10-degree sloped tailgate, and radius front corner posts, the Titan has a sleek yet strong new look.

Contractor Dump Bodies: Rugby’s Contractor Bodies offer a sleek style and the high quality and durability that you expect. Rugby’s Contractor Body has convenient fold-down sides for easy loading and un-loading of material and is available in lengths of 12′, 14′ and 16′ with volume capacities ranging from 4-6 cubic yards.

https://www.rugbymfg.com/products/elimin.title: Eliminator
intro: Rugby Manufacturing’s Eliminator LP Dump Body is the industry leader in Class 3-5. Featuring a sleek, streamlined style and designed for maximum durability, these units are available in 9′ to 12′ lengths with 12″ and 17″ side height options. The Eliminator LP is available in carbon steel, stainless steel, and aluminum. All models are available with rigid or fold-down sides.

The Eliminator LP is built with a one-piece floor, dirt shedding sides, a centrally located quick release lever (fold down side models only), and the patented EZ-LATCH™ system designed for easy tailgate operation and maximum safety. This body is designed to provide years of service.

Stainless steel dump bodies from Rugby are corrosion resistant and more durable than high tensile steel. Aluminum Eliminator LP bodies weigh up to 50% less than traditional carbon steel and provide an exceptional strength to weight ratio! This means increased payload, improved fuel efficiency, and corrosion resistance in addition to lower maintenance costs including lower tire and brake costs.

The all-new Vari-Class™ Platform Line from Rugby Mfg. is a modular solution that turns one simple platform into a multitude of possibilities. This is not just a product, it’s a system. The Vari Flat platform base, formerly Series 2000, has been redesigned with standardized side pockets that fit all Vari Side options. The Vari Sides, made of galvannealed steel , can be interchanged to fit the needs of the user, whether hauling pallets, landscaping supplies, equipment, or more.
